title: Patcher output — one task record
description: What the orchestrator recorded for one bug. Two kinds of fact live here and are never merged: MEASURED (the runner executed something and observed the result) and ATTESTED (the agent said so). Where they disagree the measurement is authoritative and the disagreement is itself recorded — that delta is the input to verifier calibration on the sighted side.

chunk_id.description: v3 only. The chunk whose agent owned this task.

task_id.description: v3 only. Scratch directory name, chunk-qualified. Two bugs share one when the second reused the first's characterisation.

file.description: v3 only. Same value as `location.file`, lifted so a chunk's records can be grouped without reaching into the object.

reused_from.description: v3 only. The bug whose characterisation artefacts this task was measured against, when they were reused rather than re-paid for. Non-null forces `fixed_workflow_only`: the probe was written for another defect.

disposition_basis.description: How the disposition was reached. `measured` = this process ran something and observed the result. `attested` = it rests on the agent's own report. v3's fix phase is measured: the orchestrator runs V1–V4 at each round boundary. Its first three runs recorded `attested` there because the reconcile loop was prompt text with nothing driving it, so the round budget was unverifiable; what is still attested is the pre-fix characterisation and the `already_remediated` decision that rests on it. A green count whose basis is `attested` is a self-report and must never be pooled with one whose basis is `measured`.

merge_verdict.description: v3 only. Whether this task's chunk survived the merge queue. A rejected submission is rolled back byte for byte, so none of its tasks reached the trunk.

disposition_before_merge.description: v3 only. Present when the merge queue overturned a disposition, so an integration failure does not erase the outcome the agent actually reached.

attested_characterisation.description: v3 only. The agent's own account of its pre-fix oracle, read from `characterisation.json`. Kept separate from `measured.characterisation` and never merged with it.

location.description: Copied from the bug report so a record is readable on its own.

disposition.description: Terminal state. `fixed`, `fixed_workflow_only` and `fixed_workflow_red` are never summed into one bucket. `fixed_workflow_only` means the vulnerability was never demonstrated in-sandbox, so the remediation gate was skipped rather than passed and axis A is unverified. `fixed_workflow_red` means the probe stopped proving the defect while the workflow test or the regression net was still red when the budget ran out, so axis B is contested: nothing here can tell an assertion that encoded the vulnerable behaviour from a fix that broke the feature. The agent's own account of which assertions it left red lives in `attested.workflow_red` and is recorded, never adjudicated.

disposition_reason.description: Required non-null for every disposition except `fixed`. Says what actually stopped the task, in the runner's words, not the agent's.

measured.description: Facts the orchestrator observed by executing something.

workflow_green_pre_fix.description: Gate G1, measured: the workflow test run against the untouched tree. False means the task's own oracle was already red before the fix, so a red workflow gate afterwards is not evidence the change broke anything. Null means NOT MEASURED, never measured-and-false.

probe_proven_pre_fix.description: Gate G2. False means axis A is unverifiable in-sandbox for this task. Null means NOT MEASURED — v3 does not re-run the probe pre-fix and records the agent's verdict in `attested_characterisation` instead.

attempts.description: Characterise invocations paid for. Zero when the artefacts were reused from an earlier task in the same chunk.

antioracle_tests.description: Net rows recognised as asserting attack-dependent behaviour, which V4 will not charge as regressions. Empty where no detector ran.

baseline_failures.description: Related tests already red at TASK start, not run start. Excluded from this task's regression count so damage done by an earlier task is not charged here.

rounds.description: One entry per FIX/VERIFY pass. Index 0 is the first fix; 1..N are reconciles.

gate_seconds.description: Seconds per gate for this round. How much of a run's wall clock was gates rather than agent — the question asked when sizing the next dataset.

excused.description: Regression rows V4 declined to charge, and why. Recorded rather than dropped: an exclusion nobody can see is indistinguishable from a gate that was never run. Names test files, so per-task record only.

gates.description: The four gate verdicts. The bare `V1`..`V4` keys are a duplicate marker written by `verify.VerifyResult.fail` alongside the long name; they carry no information the long names do not, and are named here only because the record really does contain them.

rounds_to_green.description: Null when the task never went green. The main cost lever; recorded per task rather than averaged so the distribution survives.

rounds_used.description: Rounds this process ran and measured. NEVER `attested.rounds_used`, which is the agent's claim about itself and is recorded separately so the two can be compared.

label.description: The fix loop's four-square reading of the gates on the round whose tree was kept, before it is mapped to a disposition. Null when the task never reached a fix phase.

deadline_exceeded.description: True when the task's wall-clock budget, not its round budget, ended the loop. An infrastructure limit must never be read later as a reasoning result.

gates_run.description: Gate suites this process ran for the task, one per measured round. Zero means the task never reached its fix phase.

gates_not_run_reason.description: Why `gates_run` is zero. Null when gates ran.

invocations.description: Every agent invocation for this task, characterise included. The per-round `agent` entries cover the fix loop only, and a roll-up built from those alone under-reports a run's spend by the whole characterise phase.

cost_usd.description: Sum of measured per-invocation cost from the runtime's own reporting. Never estimated. Null if the runtime did not report it.

attested.description: The agent's own claim, verbatim. Evidence about the agent, never about the patch.

workflow_red.description: Workflow assertions the agent left failing, as `<test file> :: <it() title>`. Empty means the agent claims the workflow test is green — silence is a claim, not an absence of one. Located material: it names test files, so it stays in the per-task record and never reaches a published aggregate row.

antioracle_claims.description: The subset of `workflow_red` the agent believes asserts the vulnerable behaviour itself. Recorded verbatim and never adjudicated here; the orchestrator runs no test.

attestation_delta.description: Set when the agent's claim and the measurement disagree. Present or absent, this field is never used to alter `disposition`.

touched_outside_bug_file.description: Advisory. Legitimate for a shared-utility fix, a warning sign for over-patching. Never blocks.

net_deletion.description: True when removals exceed additions by a wide margin. The signature of fixing by deleting the feature, which scores as a failure.

violations.description: Rules the runner had to enforce rather than merely state. Non-empty is a finding about the architecture, not only about the run.

invocation.description: One agent run. Usage is captured from the runtime's own output.
